description: Visual element matching (image criterion) on a macOS native app surface — the A2 analogue of app-visual-find.spec.json. A full-window screenshot of TextEdit becomes the template, and a find with that image must match it through window-element capture + template matching + page-source recovery (screen-coordinate rebase onto the window). The runCode step asserts the imageMatch score so a silently-skipped match can't pass. TextEdit + untitled-document args mirror app-surfaces-macos.spec.json; elsewhere the context lands SKIPPED.

runCode.code: const score = Number(process.env.VF_APP_SCORE_MAC); if (!(score >= 0.8)) { console.error('imageMatch.score missing or too low: ' + process.env.VF_APP_SCORE_MAC); process.exit(1); } console.log('imageMatch.score ' + score);
